ownership: One state owner per CLUBB case; no mutable C++ globals or Native global/UDT copy. Native formal arguments retain names/order; explicit state is appended only for actual module data.

states.parameters_radiation_state: All22 Native fields, names/order/kinds retained. Fixed lookup arrays have20 core-real entries; config remains host metadata.
states.extended_atmosphere_state: Two dimension integers and seven owned Real1D Views; heights [m],temperature [K],pressure [mb]. Returned bounds stay Native one-based.
states.radiation_variables_state: Nine regular fields plus19 double-precision extension diagnostic arrays and four indices; Native allocation/reset/cleanup semantics.
states.simple_rad_state: Owned33-height and33x36 heating table Views, with height/time axes retained.
states.soil_vegetation_state: Case-owned l_soil_veg; three temperatures remain ordinary Native formals.

input_fields_agreement: Sounding read_sounding and its two extension helpers append const parameters_radiation_state& parameters_radiation and extended_atmosphere_state& extended_atmosphere. No Native global copy.
public_storage_adapters: HostSpace/strided fields stage through the existing shared array owner; no local conversion registry or scalar bridge in device kernels.
Native_stats: Existing caller-owned f2k::stats_type and stats_update. Scalar column indices are converted to the established zero-based bridge convention.
SILHS_next: Eleven Native files including mt95. parameters_silhs.hpp type/API contract is stabilized for Microphys; bodies follow Radiation handoff.
